card.name: Linking words in science news prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "that", "of" and commas inside long sentences in science news articles. They appear where a researchers' finding or method is being explained.

modes.label: Relative "that"
modes.description: The word "that" begins a clause describing a substance or values in a research finding.
modes.example: Vince's team also found that diacetyl has an architecture similar to a substance<< that>> makes beta-amyloid proteins clump

modes.label: "of" after a method noun
modes.description: The word "of" follows a noun about the scientists' work or materials.
modes.example: used the chemistry<< of>> the volcanic layers to correlate the dated layers

modes.label: Math or theory nouns
modes.description: A noun about calculation or theory, such as formulas or equations, in a research story.
modes.example: had independently calculated Neptune’s position using mathematical<< formulas>>.
